verdict.rationale: Superset is local-first: code stays on your machine in ordinary Git worktrees and branches, and work is integrated through standard branches and PRs, so the core code output is already in an open format with no lock-in. Tasks, workspaces, projects and automations can be read programmatically through the documented CLI, TypeScript SDK and a public OpenAPI 3.1 API, which could serve as a self-built export path. However, no dedicated export feature is documented. missing for 10: a documented one-step export of all account data (tasks, automations, settings, history), a stated open export format, an account-deletion/offboarding flow, and independent confirmation that leaving is clean.
